The opposing case is strongest when it treats a separate loop wrapper as **feature isolation**: keep `run-step5-review.sh` frozen as the single-round contract that `scripts/test-run-step5-review.sh` and `scripts/run-step5-review.md` already describe, and hang multi-round orchestration on a new executable so rollback and mental models stay “round script vs loop script” instead of “one script, two modes.”

<claim>
Co-locating multi-round dispatch in `scripts/run-step5-review.sh` and adding `run_implement_loop` beside `run_implement_round` in `skills/review-and-fix/scripts/review-and-fix.sh` keeps argv assembly, degraded-round cap inflation, and the diff-mode round primitive in one proven pipeline instead of splitting them across a third launcher.

<evidence>
`scripts/run-step5-review.sh:135-169` derives `ROUND_CAP`, inflates it with `count_prior_degraded_rounds`, builds `REVIEW_AND_FIX_ARGS` including `--mode diff` and `--round-num`, and execs `review-and-fix.sh` in one place; `skills/review-and-fix/scripts/review-and-fix.sh:896-898` defines `run_implement_round` as the `--mode diff` round entrypoint; `skills/implement/SKILL.md:1207-1217` still instructs the main agent to run one foreground Bash call per round, which is the cost pattern the loop is meant to collapse.

<strongest_concession>
A new top-level loop wrapper cleanly quarantines experimental control flow so the existing launcher file can remain strictly “one `--round-num`, one exec” for readers who already treat it as the canonical single-round surface.

<counter_to_opposition>
Quarantine does not require a third script: a launcher-level `--mode loop` (or default loop with an explicit per-round escape) preserves one resolver for `RUN_ID`, `plan.txt`, and `CODEX_PRESENT`/`CURSOR_PRESENT` forwarding while a separate wrapper either duplicates that resolution or couples through `source`/re-invocation that is easier to drift than extending the code at `scripts/run-step5-review.sh:110-169`.

<risk_if_wrong>
If this hosting choice is rejected in favor of scattered entrypoints without tightening `skills/implement/SKILL.md:1207-1217`, the main agent keeps paying one full transcript turn per round; if the wrapper path duplicates launch logic, round-cap or env forwarding can diverge from `run-step5-review.sh` and produce silent behavioral skew between harness, docs, and production Step 5.

RECOMMEND: THESIS
